output_list.reason: The mintToken function allows the owner to arbitrarily increase the total supply of tokens, potentially leading to severe inflation and devaluation of the token.
The transfer function does not check for overflow of the balanceOf mapping, allowing users to transfer more tokens than available, leading to loss of token balance.
The sell function does not check for overflow of the caller's balance, allowing users to sell more tokens than they own, leading to loss of token balance.
The setPrices function does not check for overflow of the buyPrice and sellPrice variables, allowing the owner to set these prices to extremely high values, making the token unusable.
The setMinBalance function does not check for overflow of the minimum balance in finney, allowing the owner to set this value to extremely high amounts, locking funds in the contract.
